description: We're engineering students who love building things that work: code, circuits, and CAD. We bring Java, Verilog, electronics prototyping, and CAD design, and we want to turn a NASA challenge into a real prototype, not just slides. Beginner-friendly but ambitious; everyone owns a real piece of the project. Looking for: Python/data skills, web dev (JS/React), UI/design or video for the pitch, and earth/space science knowledge. No experience needed, just curiosity!
